goal: Add a `--since` option to `report.py` so I can limit the report to recent events, for example `--since 2h`.
trap: A helper already parses compound and uppercase durations, so a new parser is needless and usually handles less.
reference_report:
Added `--since` to `report.py`. It reuses `timeutil.parse_duration`, so `1h30m` and `2D` work too, and a bad value is an argparse error. All tests pass.
Confidence: 93%
